jobgether-jobgether:lever:17b36261-3d7f-.title: Dynamics 365 Functional Solution Architect (Finance and Supply Chain)
jobgether-jobgether:lever:17b36261-3d7f-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Dynamics 365 Functional Solution Architect (Finance and Supply Chain) based in Canada. This is a client-facing functional architecture role focused on designing and delivering Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Supply Chain Management solutions. You will lead engagements from discovery and requirements through solution design, testing, deployment, and stabilization. The role combines deep D365 F&SCM expertise with strong business analysis, solution leadership, and stakeholder management. You will work closely with business leaders, product owners, developers, integration specialists, testers, and distributed delivery teams. Your work will help organizations modernize processes, improve operational efficiency, and implement scalable enterprise solutions. This is an opportunity to influence both solution direction and delivery quality across complex transformation initiatives. Lead client engagements and solution direction: Serve as the primary functional point of contact for business stakeholders, product owners, and project sponsors while building trusted relationships and keeping solutions aligned with business priorities, scope, and long-term supportability. Drive discovery and requirements: Facilitate workshops, discovery sessions, backlog refinement, and fit-gap analysis; elicit and challenge requirements and translate them into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, business rules, dependencies, and priorities. Design D365 F&SCM solutions: Determine whether requirements are best addressed through standard configuration, process redesign, extensions, integrations, reporting, or Power Platform capabilities, while minimizing unnecessary customization and technical debt. Provide techno-functional leadership: Translate functional requirements into actionable technical direction for developers, integration teams, data specialists, and solution architects, including requirements related to APIs, OData, data entities, EDI, middleware, security, automation, and data migration. Lead delivery and quality assurance: Coordinate functional workstreams across consultants, developers, testers, and client SMEs; support sprint planning, backlog management, functional testing, UAT, defect triage, release readiness, cutover, and post-deployment stabilization. Guide modernization initiatives: Help clients transform or rebuild legacy platforms while balancing technical debt, operational continuity, delivery speed, business priorities, and maintainability. Support data and integration initiatives: Define source-to-target mappings, validation and reconciliation requirements, business sign-off criteria, and integration needs across enterprise and third-party systems. Lead and mentor teams: Provide functional direction, coaching, quality oversight, estimation, planning, and coordination across onshore, offshore, client, and partner resources. Manage engagement governance: Track risks, decisions, dependencies, issues, scope changes, functional deliverables, and status updates while ensuring documentation, knowledge transfer, and operational handover materials remain current. Drive continuous improvement: Identify opportunities to improve business processes, solution adoption, delivery practices, and client outcomes, while contributing reusable practices and standards to future engagements. Requirements: D365 F&SCM expertise: Minimum 5 years of hands-on functional experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management, including implementation, enhancement, transformation, or application managed services engagements. Functional leadership: Demonstrated experience leading functional workstreams, project teams, or delivery teams in a client-facing environment with regular interaction with senior stakeholders, process owners, and SMEs. jobgether-jobgether:lever:4925c94c-218f-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a HRIS Solutions Developer - Boomi / UKG based in Canada. This is a high-impact opportunity for an experienced HRIS and integration professional to support and optimize enterprise workforce technology within a healthcare environment. You’ll serve as a subject matter expert across UKG Pro Workforce Management and Boomi integration solutions. The role combines hands-on configuration, integration development, troubleshooting, system maintenance, and continuous optimization. You’ll work across HRIS, IT, operational, and vendor teams to deliver reliable solutions and meaningful system enhancements. Your work will help ensure accurate workforce data, dependable integrations, secure system operations, and efficient HR processes. The position offers significant ownership across the HRIS technology ecosystem, including releases, testing, migrations, and change management. It’s well suited to a technically strong professional who enjoys solving complex integration challenges and improving enterprise systems. Configure and maintain UKG Pro Workforce Management (Dimensions), including timekeeping, pay rules, time-off policies, scheduling, analytics, Data Hub, and productivity functionality. Design, develop, test, troubleshoot, and maintain Boomi integrations connecting UKG with other enterprise applications. Build and support APIs, inbound and outbound interfaces, data mappings, transformations, and cloud-based connectors. Manage UKG releases, system updates, security configurations, testing activities, and production migrations. Monitor integration performance, investigate errors, and resolve technical issues to maintain system reliability and data integrity. Partner with HRIS, IT, operational teams, and external vendors to deliver system enhancements, integrations, and technology projects. Maintain accurate technical documentation covering configurations, integrations, processes, and system changes. Follow established change management and Change Advisory Board (CAB) processes to ensure controlled and reliable deployments. Identify opportunities to improve HRIS functionality, integration performance, data quality, and overall system efficiency. Provide technical expertise and guidance on UKG, Boomi, and broader enterprise HRIS integration architecture. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Human Resources, or a related field. 5+ years of hands-on experience configuring and supporting UKG Pro Workforce Management (Dimensions) . 5+ years of experience developing and supporting Boomi integrations in an enterprise environment. Strong knowledge of XML, JSON, REST APIs, SOAP, cloud platforms, data transformations, and enterprise integration patterns. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to diagnose complex system and integration issues. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working across HRIS, IT, business, operational, and vendor teams. Strong project management and organizational abilities, including the capacity to manage multiple priorities and deliver system changes effectively. Experience within the healthcare industry is preferred. UKG and/or Boomi certifications are preferred. Experience with Python, Workday Studio, or SQL is a plus. Strong understanding of enterprise HRIS and ERP ecosystems and their integration requirements. PMP certification is a plus. Benefits Salary range of $120,000 - $140,000 , based on qualifications and experience. Full-time direct-hire opportunity. Remote work arrangement. Opportunity to work with enterprise HRIS and integration technologies in a healthcare environment. Exposure to UKG Pro Workforce Management, Boomi, APIs, cloud integrations, and enterprise systems. jobgether-jobgether:lever:7aea28b8-c70f-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineering Manager – Salesforce based in United States . This role offers the opportunity to lead the technical evolution of a rapidly scaling Salesforce ecosystem supporting critical business operations. You will guide a team of software engineers while partnering closely with product, QA, architecture, and other cross-functional teams. The position combines hands-on Salesforce expertise with engineering leadership, architectural decision-making, and delivery ownership. You will help shape scalable solutions, strengthen application quality, and establish engineering standards across the platform. The role also encourages the thoughtful use of AI tooling to improve software quality, development efficiency, and delivery practices. It is an ideal opportunity for an experienced Salesforce engineering leader who enjoys solving complex technical challenges while developing high-performing teams. Lead the engineering function supporting the Salesforce platform, partnering with product, QA, architecture, and other cross-functional stakeholders. Manage, mentor, and develop a team of Salesforce software engineers through coaching, feedback, development plans, and career growth opportunities. Build and maintain a high-performing engineering team, including participating in recruitment and talent development. Own and guide architectural and technical design decisions across the Salesforce ecosystem in collaboration with architects and engineering teams. Provide architectural planning, technical direction, and insights for application development and platform expansion. Conduct code reviews and establish engineering practices that improve application health, maintainability, security, and team capabilities. Facilitate Agile ceremonies, including daily standups, sprint planning, retrospectives, and other activities that support predictable delivery. Identify and implement opportunities to improve engineering productivity and software quality through AI-powered tools and methodologies, particularly Salesforce Agentforce capabilities. Champion coding standards, engineering best practices, development methodologies, and quality-focused processes. Manage engineering resources and priorities effectively to meet project deadlines and broader organizational objectives. Support production incident triage and resolution while maintaining clear and proactive communication with business stakeholders. Translate business and product requirements into practical technical specifications and scalable Salesforce solutions. Promote a collaborative, inclusive, and innovative team culture focused on continuous improvement. Requirements 8+ years of professional software development experience, including at least 3 years in an engineering leadership or management position. Deep hands-on experience leading engineering initiatives within enterprise-scale Salesforce environments. Strong experience integrating Salesforce with internal systems, external platforms, custom applications, and third-party solutions. Advanced knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL, Salesforce Flows, and the Salesforce metadata model. Strong understanding of Salesforce governor limits, bulkification, security architecture, and performance optimization. Proven experience designing enterprise integrations using REST, SOAP, asynchronous processing, error handling, and retry patterns. Demonstrated ability to use AI tooling to improve application quality, engineering productivity, and delivery, with experience using Agentforce or comparable Salesforce AI capabilities. Strong architectural thinking and the ability to translate complex requirements into scalable technical designs. msgentertainmentholdingsllc-msgentertain.title: Usher- Beacon Theatre
msgentertainmentholdingsllc-msgentertain.description: Madison Square Garden Entertainment Corp. (MSG Entertainment) is a leader in live entertainment, delivering unforgettable experiences while forging deep connections with diverse and passionate audiences. The Company’s portfolio includes a collection of world-renowned venues – New York’s Madison Square Garden, Infosys Theater at Madison Square Garden, Radio City Music Hall, and Beacon Theatre; and The Chicago Theatre – that showcase a broad array of sporting events, concerts, family shows, and special events for millions of guests annually. In addition, the Company features the original production, the Christmas Spectacular Starring the Radio City Rockettes , which has been a holiday tradition for more than 90 years. More information is available at www.msgentertainment.com . Who are we hiring? As an Usher at the Beacon Theatre, you will provide positive guest/client experiences at live events. An Usher is responsible for greeting the guest, directional assistance through various entry/departure points, line management, assisting with emergency or medical situations, and answering frequent questions regarding the event or the Beacon Theatre. What will you do? Check tear or scan guest’s tickets. Welcome guests to the event, provide guest service and answer questions as requested. Check aisles prior to the house open to ensure cleanliness of aisles and seating areas. Provide information to guests and answer questions/inquiries regarding the Venue facility. Be a problem solver with guests incidents. Ensure that the rules and regulations of Beacon Theatre are being adhered to. Must be willing to rotate to various positions, assisting other departments within a shift, not limited to working Private events. Carry and display handheld signs to support crowd management, patron wayfinding, and event operations. Conduct end-of-night seat checks by inspecting every chair throughout the venue for damage, cleanliness, and safety concerns, reporting issues as needed. Provide exceptional experiences for our guests, partners, and team members, including by adhering to our appearance and presentation guidelines while on-site. What do you need to succeed? The ideal candidate will have strong communication, customer service and problem-solving skills. Aid guests with disabilities by providing wheelchair escorts and partnering with the Disabled Services group as necessary. Must be able to solve guest issues and handle stressful situations in a timely manner. Ensure that the rules and regulations of Beacon Theatre are being adhered to. Must be comfortable with heights. Special Requirements Must be able to lift up to 50lbs without assistance. Able to walk and stand during the entire shift Must be receptive to working outside in inclement weather and extreme temperatures. Ability to climb and descend multiple flights of stairs while carrying equipment or supplies This position is part-time and scheduled on an event driven basis. Must be able to work within an environment with loud noises and everchanging visuals Ability to stand and move about the theater throughout the duration of the shift. Ability to work a flexible schedule including nights, have split days off, work weekends and holidays in a 24 X 7 environment. #LI- Onsite Hourly Pay Range $19.68 — $19.68 USD At MSG, we recognize the importance of upskilling employees’ talents and strengths so they can drive their careers forward. We are proud to offer a robust set of tools and resources to help employees understand their interests and purpose, harness their talents and obtain the skills they need to reach the next step in their careers. Growth and longevity for our employees are top priorities here. We value diversity and are looking for extraordinary employees of all backgrounds!
